evidence.quote: Population pharmacokinetic parameters of VOR in rats (autoinduction model)
S06 | DOI 10.1128/AAC.01556-08 | Table 2 (van de Sande et al. 2009)

Neutropenic female RP strain albino rats (age and weight not reported); PK groups of 9 uninfected neutropenic rats. Vfend INTRAPERITONEAL q12h for 10 days in four regimens: 2.6 mg/kg; 5 mg/kg; 6, 8, 10, 11 mg/kg on days 1-4 then 12 mg/kg; 7.5, 10, 12.5, 15 mg/kg on days 1-4 then 17.5 mg/kg. Sampling days 0, 5 and 9, three times per rat (0, 2, 8 h; 0.5, 4, 10 h; 1, 6, 12 h); retro-orbital plasma; agar-diffusion bioassay (C. albicans), standards 0.125-4 µg/ml; binding not measured.

NONMEM model with Michaelis-Menten elimination and enzyme autoinduction: "the amount of enzyme is increased sixfold on the last day, producing a comparable increase in the Vmax." Footnote a: "Standard errors of the estimates were <42%." V in ml and Vmax in μg/h are per animal.
Measured concentrations are in Fig. 1 only (days 0 and 9 at 7.5 and 17.5 mg/kg; not digitized; legend does not say whether dots are individual rats).

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T2:A25 supplies dosing and sampling context, but the table body contains reported parameters. F0003:S2:T2:A27 places measured concentrations only in an undigitized figure and leaves point-level animal identity unspecified. Concentration-time measurements are MISSING from this reviewed item; overall modeling-input coverage remains UNRESOLVED. A sampling-time origin relative to dosing is not explicitly stated.
findings.needed_material: At a later authorized step, obtain permitted measured concentration-time records or approved figure extraction with source provenance, time origin, regimen and treatment-day membership, experimental-unit or summary definitions, and missingness metadata. Do not substitute fitted parameters for measured concentrations.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T2:A25 states intraperitoneal repeat dosing, neutropenic uninfected rats, plasma and a bioassay, and explicitly says binding was not measured. Total versus unbound concentration basis and chemical dose basis are NOT_FOUND. Assay standards of 0.125-4 µg/ml are stated, but detection limits, quantification limits and censoring definitions are NOT_FOUND. These omissions do not establish absence elsewhere.
findings.needed_material: Confirm concentration and dose bases and applicable assay-limit and missingness definitions during authorized preparation. Preserve the reported route, matrix, immune and infection state, assay and dosing-day distinctions; document any proposed conversion.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T2:A25 describes four regimens, escalating dose histories and sampling days 0, 5 and 9. F0003:S2:T2:A27 describes figure concentrations only for days 0 and 9 at 7.5 and 17.5 mg/kg. This item does not establish measured coverage for every regimen, day or phase, or the allocation of sampling-time triplets to identified animals. The published nonlinear and autoinduction model description does not establish independent estimability from available inputs.
findings.needed_material: Retain all stated dose histories and obtain source-linked sample-to-regimen/day assignments through authorized preparation. Leave design sufficiency, identifiability and held-out prediction opportunities to downstream animal PK assessment.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T2:A25 explicitly says age and weight were not reported. F0003:S2:T2:A26 states that V in ml and Vmax in μg/h are per animal. Actual study body weights needed for any body-size-dependent use are therefore unresolved; these published parameters are not qualified human-translation inputs.
findings.needed_material: Before a body-size-dependent translation decision, obtain authorized study-specific weights or retain the unsupported normalization as an explicit limitation. Do not substitute typical rat weights or convert per-animal parameters without justification.

findings.reason: F0003:S2:T2:A25 identifies two escalating intraperitoneal regimens. The item does not identify which, if either, corresponds to the human-exposure-target regimen in SC028, or provide an input-use plan. Regimen identification provides partial coverage only; it does not authorize use for tuning scaling.
findings.needed_material: Independently review the source-supported association with SC028 and record permitted uses before downstream selection. Apply the supplied restrictions on scaling and human-outcome leakage without inferring an association from species or escalation alone.

findings.reason: Origin: main:/missing_information/items/5. Status DEFERRED; resolution_status OPEN; needed_at pk. Support for individual PK variability remains unassessed.
